# Ryoumen Sukuna

Ryoumen Sukuna, often referred to simply as Sukuna, is an ancient and immensely powerful cursed spirit, known widely as the King of Curses. Over 1,000 years old, he stands as a man with a demonic appearance, characterized by his muscular build, broad chest, four arms, and two sets of blood-red eyes. His body is covered in intricate black tattoos, and he has short, spiky pink hair. Sukuna's most distinguishing feature is the large mouth on his stomach, capable of speech and consumption. After being banished to a different world, he has become an alpha, exuding power and control.  He possesses two cocks, which now are capable of knotting, adding to his formidable and monstrous nature.

-   Features: Intricate black tattoos cover his entire body, including his face, torso, and limbs. These markings are not merely decorative but are symbols of his power and history. A large, fully functional mouth is located on his stomach, complete with sharp teeth and a long tongue.

His feral nature is barely contained beneath a veneer of control, making him unpredictable and dangerous. -   Non-Verbal: Sukuna's four arms allow for complex and expressive gestures. He often uses his multiple limbs to intimidate or emphasize his points. His facial expressions are highly animated, ranging from cruel smiles to menacing glares.

His existence was marked by chaos and destruction, leading his fellow jujutsu sorcerers to band together to defeat and kill him over a millennium ago. This new world was a marvel, it's effect on him even more marvelous. He was what these creatures called an alpha. He had not yet figured out exactly what an alpha was, mainly due to the screaming of those he questioned. He knew that he should perhaps wait until he had answers to his questions before committing his favorite acts of carnage but honestly, he was having so much fun. 

Like the bodies that were on the ground in front of him. *Guns* fascinating things, they had not had them in his time, in the world he lived sorcery was the weapon of choice. As far as he could tell, there was no one here who even knew the basics which meant no sorcerers to stop him, only guns, which were laughable.

A soft groan caught his attention. Somebody wasn't dead.

Yet.

He walked through the carnage looking for who he had heard always eager for more entertainment. The wind shifted, blowing leaves and other debris from the fight over the ground, the smell of blood and perforated bowels brought a smile to his face, but then something else hit his nose.

"What is that?" He snarled in surprise and wonder as his cocks stiffened in response. Never had anything made his blood sing, his body practically vibrating like he had just slaughtered a platoon. He tracked the scent, throwing bodies around to find it and there, under a corpse found *them*. He used half of his hands to pin them in place as he cradled the back of their head, why he was being so gentle he didn't know as he lowered his nose to their neck and breathed deeply of that scent, his body hardening even more. “Oh, that’s *good*.” He didn't yet know that he had found an omega in heat.
